THREE new findings, each requiring its own Jordan-reviewed default before U2 can safely land (none implemented this pass -- no risky guess committed to engine code):

(1) PERCUSSION SELF-GATE REMOVAL PRODUCES A SEVERE BALANCE REGRESSION, NOT 'ships weak' (JD-4's own framing). Root cause: PERC_SCALE/PERC_EXP were fit ONLY against dedicated blunt weapons (whose entire forward mass IS the striking surface); a sword's percussion-capable mass is specifically its small rear pommel, not its whole blade+PoB -- the existing whole-weapon formula has no way to distinguish these cases. JD-4's 'ships weak' default cannot be honored by a bare self-gate removal; a genuinely NEW pommel-specific percussion sub-model (grounded per this repo's own combat-grounding-methodology: derive from the pommel's own mass_kg/x_m via percussion_element_authority, not the whole-weapon formula) is needed first. NOT implemented.

(2) weapon_physics.thrust_factor (geometry.py) carries its OWN undocumented floor bug, structurally identical to cut_factor's already-flagged 0.45 floor: its formula (0.35 + 0.65*point_concentration) times a cross_section term never reaches 0 even at point_concentration=0 (a broad, pointless face). Measured: mace (pc=0.02, pure blunt face) scores thrust=0.34; staff scores 0.31 -- both nontrivial 'thrust' readings for weapons with no point at all, purely from their rigid cross_section. This forces any MODE_TIP_MIN choice into an uncomfortably narrow band (0.34-0.37) to satisfy the plan's own test_mace_staff_no_thrust (must exclude mace 0.34/staff 0.31) AND test_greatsword_katana_sabre_afford_thrust (must include sabre, whose thrust=0.37 clears that same window by only 0.03) -- a fragile margin this repo's own anti-sim-fit principle (Jordan memory: combat-grounding-methodology) warns against accepting silently. Proposed default (not applied): drop thrust_factor's own floor the same way U2 already drops cut_factor's, widening the margin -- but this is an ADDITIONAL formula change beyond consolidation_v1's literal text and needs the same sign-off as JD-1 was, not a silent bundle.

(3) The graded-affordance change (decoupling element_afforded's per-mode gating from the head category) has a MUCH wider blast radius than the plan's 5 named acceptance tests. Verified directly: test_combat_invariants.py already carries exact-set assertions for composite weapons (test_afforded_heads_emerge_from_phase_b2_mode_elements: ji=={point,curved_cut}, guisarme=={cut_thrust,point}, voulge, bec_de_corbin, lucerne_hammer, goedendag, poleaxe) that a straightforward head-independent secondary cut/point check WOULD break -- e.g. ji's point-tokened spearhead element carries edge_keenness=0.40 in its own per-mode_element geometry, comfortably clearing a MODE_EDGE_MIN~=0.15 floor and adding a THIRD 'cut' token to a set the existing test pins at exactly two. Landing U2 correctly requires re-deriving the expected new set for every composite weapon in the roster (the same rigor as a fixture regeneration, but with no existing 'right answer' to check against), not just the 5 single-mode weapons the plan names.

RECOMMENDATION: resolve (1) and (2) as their own Jordan-reviewed forks (proposed as JD-9 and JD-10 respectively, extending consolidation_v1.md section 6) before attempting U2's implementation; (3) is a scope/effort note for whoever implements U2, not a design fork. PERCUSSION -> STAMINA (wind) + STRONG POISE STAGGER (Jordan directive 'strong strong poise break'; the percussion->stamina thread from 'using the staff to butt someone ... you're still receiving an impact that is either counter to your movement or your stamina'). A landed blow now delivers a concussive IMPULSE DISTINCT from the wound, applied at every hit site (stop-hit, closed hit, bind hit, riposte): it DRAINS the victim's STAMINA (wind knocked out of you / attrition) and BREAKS their POISE (a strong stagger; poise feeds tempo+defence via poise_factor). Single owner: systems.percussion_stagger(striker, victim, wound, deg, cfg) -> (stamina_drain, poise_break). ARMOUR-GATED by physics (the anti-plate blunt path; Medieval Chronicles blunt-weapons, tempered by Devereaux 'Punching Through Some Armor Myths' — plate+padding soaks much): a BLUNT/percussion head transmits its impulse THROUGH the harness (a mace/warhammer/staff-butt concusses even when the plate holds), scaled by percussion_authority x PERC_BLUNT_TRANSMIT[armor] (per-tier absorption); a POINT/cut delivers its energy as the WOUND (penetration) and only a FRACTION as concussion (PERC_POINT_FRAC), AND winds via FLESH contact so it fades with the victim's armour (a glancing sword-poke that can't defeat plate delivers ~0 concussion) — this keeps a plate STALEMATE a stalemate (PC-5: two swords that can't defeat each other's plate don't wind each other to a decision) and stops a weak plate-poke over-draining a gap-specialist's wind. WHY the staff/blunt is now effective: a staff (m_head~0 -> wound~0) still winds and staggers via its concussive impulse without drawing blood. Poise DEEPENED so a stagger is DECISIVE not a nudge: POISE_EFFECT_FLOOR 0.88->0.72 (a fully-staggered fighter acts/defends at 0.72x, ~2.3x the prior 12% penalty) + POISE_FLOOR 0.5->0.40 (a hard concussion drives structure lower). CEILING: the stagger depth + percussion magnitude are capped by TWO invariants — the PC-5 plate-stalemate (a deeper poise turns armoured sword-duels into decisions, test_combat_balance_guard) and the tradition-lever TEXTURE test (too strong a stagger shortens fights and washes out the subtle edge-read/bind levers, test_combat_tradition_levers); both are physically honest limits on 'strong strong'. NOT the estoc/staff crux fix (staff still loses to a sharp longsword/estoc it cannot wound, ~5-6%; that residual is honest physics per ED-PC-0030) — this is grounded blunt/concussion/wind realism. PENETRATION THRESHOLD (rapier plate fall-off) — executes the held rapier fix from the ED-PC-0029 arc (Jordan directive 'resolve rapier and stale grip bug'). A thin, precise point (rapier) was field-WINNING at plate against weapons that cannot defeat it (heavy field-win ~74%) — a physics inversion: a weapon whose point does not DEFEAT the harness should not accumulate lethal wounds through it. Fix: a soft Hill knee applied to the POST-COUPLING damage in core.damage() — `t = PEN_THR.get(armor, 0.0); if t>0 and raw>0: raw *= raw*raw/(raw*raw + t*t)`. Below the threshold t the blow is scrubbed toward 0 (a glancing/non-defeating hit inflicts little LASTING wound); well above t it passes through ~unchanged (a true armour-defeat is untouched). PEN_THR = {none:0.0, light:0.0, medium:2.5, heavy:6.5}: gambeson/none is SOFT (no penetration floor — gated t=0 so the light-armour default that the tradition-lever-texture invariant reads is BYTE-UNCHANGED; the rapier inversion is a plate-tier problem, not a gambeson one), medium a mild knee, heavy the full floor. Single owner: core.PEN_THR + the knee in core.damage(); exported to engine_params/combat_engine_v1.json (core section, round-trip green). RESULT: rapier heavy field-win 74% -> 32% (no longer inverts vs weapons it can't defeat); PC-5 plate-stalemate held; tradition-lever texture untouched (light t=0); full tests/valoria suite green. Grounded in penetration mechanics (a point that does not defeat the plate transfers little wounding energy), not the estoc/staff crux (that residual stays honest physics per ED-PC-0029..0031).

description: STALE-GRIP FIX + MEASURE CONTINUITY across engagements (Jordan directive 'resolve rapier and stale grip bug'; Fable read-only audit finding #7). TWO coupled fixes. (1) OPEN-MEASURE RESET: engagement() now resets each combatant's transient geometry (grip_position, lunge_depth) to the open-measure default BEFORE the opening reach_base — previously grip_position was carried on the Combatant object from the PRIOR engagement's final beat, so a weapon that ended the last engagement choked in (grip≈1) UNDER-READ its own reach at the next engagement's opening reach computation, corrupting the frozen longer/shorter labels and measure_gap for the whole new engagement. A fresh engagement physically begins at open measure (weapons at full extension), so the reset is the honest geometry. (2) RE-PRESENTATION GATE (the reason the naive reset alone was ALSO wrong): the honest reset let a reach weapon re-present its point at open measure EVERY engagement and stop-hit for free, so a spear FIELD-WON at heavy plate (~0.97 win vs arming) — a physics inversion (a plate-armoured man who does not fear a point that cannot defeat his harness crowds in and STAYS glued; the spearman cannot keep him at the point). engagement() now threads a per-turn `prev_closed` (fight() carries the ending measure state forward, first engagement always opens at measure) and, when the previous engagement ended closed and there is a reach gap, gates re-presentation on systems.represent_measure_p = exp(-REPRESENT_DECAY_K * ADEF_W[closer] * armour_defeat_deficit) * footwork, where the deficit is how far the reach weapon's realised adef_cap (its SELECTED gap-mode) falls short of the tier threshold — the SAME armour-defeat primitive reach_threat reads, but a STEEPER exp() (holding an armoured man off a whole engagement is harder than deterring one stop-hit). EXACTLY 1.0 at none/light (aw <= ADEF_W['light']): crowding is a HARD-armour phenomenon (soft gambeson still respects a thrust), so the gate is BYTE-INERT on the RNG stream off-plate — the wrapper short-circuits the rng draw when represent_p==1.0, preserving the tradition-lever texture regression (which runs at light). REPRESENT_DECAY_K=3.5, REPRESENT_FOOT_K=0.06 (config; exported to combat_engine_v1.json, round-trip green). RESULT (N=300 vs arming): spear heavy 0.97->0.08, yari ~0.40 (pure points crowded off plate — near-total stalemate loss PRESERVED, now grounded in crowding physics not a grip artifact); poleaxe heavy ~0.95 and guisarme ~0.61 (gap-defeating reach weapons still re-present — the emergent discriminator is presentation FREQUENCY, since spear and guisarme wound plate ~alike per landed hit). RE-BASELINE (flagged, not silent): fixing the bug GLOBALLY strengthens reach weapons where they re-present — spear/yari/guisarme now DOMINATE medium (~0.90-0.95, was the bug-suppressed ~0.50 near-even), which is the honest value (a mail-armoured man cannot crowd a spearman, and mail does not stop the thrust); the reach-class invariant assertions were written as one-sided floors (>0.42) so all hold, and their prose comments were updated to record the re-baseline. Full tests/valoria suite green (656 passed, 1 xpassed). description: CORRECTNESS BATCH 1 of the four-dimension read-only audit (Jordan: four independent fable-tier auditors — fiat, orphans, conflicts, tuning — each covering ALL DIRECTIONS AND CONDITIONALS; then resolve every finding in order, batch by batch, with an adversarial audit after each). Three genuine correctness defects, all verified before and after. (F1) represent_measure_p read STALE/NATIVE sel_head+grip: the ED-PC-0033 crowd gate is evaluated at ENGAGEMENT START, outside the per-beat loop that refreshes sel_*, so it read the PRIOR engagement's closed-phase selection — or, on the first engagement, nothing, falling back to the bare native head. A multi-mode weapon whose native head is a CUTTER therefore read as maximally crowded on engagement 1 and differently later (katana 0.000->0.274, guisarme 0.092->0.236, hook_sword 0.000->0.425) — the same state-carryover class ED-PC-0033 had just fixed for grip_position, reintroduced one call up. Fixed by deriving the PRESENTING mode purely and locally via select_mode(grip=0.0, room=1.0) — the open-measure geometry the gate is actually asking about. select_mode gained optional grip/room overrides following reach_base's JD-9 idiom (None=read live, explicit=pin a hypothetical), so both wrapper call sites stay byte-identical. Verified path-independent: 0/24 weapon x tier cells drift after adversarially corrupting every live circumstance field. (F2) overcommit_exposure floored only its FIRST term, returning NEGATIVE for a balanced/disciplined fighter at shallow commit (-0.37 measured); the wrapper guards its initiative/poise loss with `if >0` but fed the un-floored value into RIPOSTE_ON_FAIL/ON_NEUTRALIZE, silently pushing the defender's riposte BELOW its configured base — a mechanic the docstring ('floored at 0') said could not exist. Floor now wraps the whole expression: not over-committing means you are not EXTRA exposed, and anti-overcommit is a mitigation of exposure, not a bonus that can invert it. Verified >=0 over 80 build/commit combos. (F3) contact.grab_sigma's edge-hazard term sign-FLIPPED for grab skill>1 (skills are uncapped), so seizing an opponent's LIVE double edge bare-handed IMPROVED the grab, scaling with the grabbed blade's sharpness; mitigation clamped at 0 (immune, never rewarded). (F4) The tradition-lever texture instrument was under-powered and F2 tripped it WITHOUT touching a lever (katana 4/60->3/60). Investigated rather than re-baselined: true divergence is ~12-13% (n=200: katana 25/200, dagger 26/200), so n=60 expects 7.5 +- 2.6 and the old >=4 floor sat ~1 SE below the mean — a knife-edge; the docstring's claimed '~16-28%' was never reproducible at n=60. Raised n to 200 and set a proportional 5% floor (~2.5x margin, still reads 0 if the levers die): tightens rigour, does not relax the guard. Full tests/valoria suite green (686 passed, 1 xfailed), identical to baseline. description: FIAT RETIREMENT — batch 3 of the four-dimension read-only audit, plus the corrections the batch-1 and batch-2 adversarial reviews earned. (F11) percussion_stagger now reads the striker's sel_perc (whole-weapon only as the native fallback, exactly as core.strike does), closing a bypass of the sel_* SINGLE-SOURCE contract that core.strike's docstring declares canonical — a lucerne_hammer's rear fluke and its hammer face had been delivering identical stagger, the M-02 object-confusion class re-opened by ED-PC-0031; its inline quality ladder and strength term moved into config as PERC_QUAL/PERC_STR_BASE/PERC_STR_K, with the DELIBERATE divergence from core.QUAL stated (core scales a WOUND, this scales transmitted IMPULSE). (F13) The Nachreisen pursuit strike no longer resolves at a flat DISENGAGE_PURSUIT_NSIG: systems.pursuit_sigma (modelled on stophit_sigma, the engine's other opportunistic-strike sigma) adds bilateral wound-Ob, armour-defeat, and a footwork differential — the constant had let the most violent branch in the closed phase bypass the ENTIRE sigma-assembly, so every fighter pair resolved identically and no attribute of the withdrawer entered at all. (F12) The cut_thrust 'versatile max' was decorative: the pre-max BLENDED DELIVERY['cut_thrust']=1.35 could never beat point's 1.45 (shear-resist >= puncture-resist at every tier), so the edge arm won in 0 of 76 weapon x tier cells while select_mode independently LABELLED the mode 'shear' at none/light — a sword damaged as a thrust and read as a swing, with legibility (thrust HARD 0.80 / swing EASY 1.25) scoring a mode the fighter never performed. The branch also ignored `eff` outright, discarding the derived edge-quality and thrust-magnitude of all 19 cut_thrust weapons (sel_eff 0.63-1.14). Fixed by grading the cut arm on its OWN token, applying both arms' eff scaling, and extracting core.cut_thrust_arm as the SINGLE OWNER returning (value, mode) — so damage and label cannot diverge by construction. The shift is now real and matches the long-stated doctrine: CUT the unarmoured man, half-sword THRUST anything armoured; a poor-edged weapon (spetum, eff 0.63) correctly prefers its point even unarmoured, which no armour-keyed rule could express. golden_element_parity regenerated SURGICALLY (17 cells, damage-mode label only; a guard refused to write if any non-label field had moved). (F14/F15) ATTACKER_BIAS and UPSET_FLOOR tagged honestly rather than removed: ATTACKER_BIAS is untagged unledgered fiat that duplicates the Vor system and whose mirror-fairness defence holds only at fight aggregate (within a BURST_MAX=4 burst one fighter can bank it four times), and the 2026-06-28 critique already recommended removal — but it COMPOUNDS with the deterministic first-actor race, so deleting it in isolation would be tuning against a moving target; it retires with that structural fix. UPSET_FLOOR is a deliberate designer rule (Jordan) and stays, tagged as such, with its measurement consequence recorded: every win-rate the engine reports is compressed toward [0.05, 0.95]. ADVERSARIAL-REVIEW CORRECTIONS: the batch-1 represent gate pinned room=1.0, a geometry the engine never occupies (its real beat-1 room is range_utilization(gap) ~0.43-0.66) — it made the gate grade the guisarme's BILL-CUT rather than its point, against the gate's own 'respect the point' fiction, costing ~4pp; now derived from measure_gap, which also makes that parameter load-bearing. Three audit repro scripts that import the LIVE engine were broken by batch 2's `close` removal (the sweep stopped at the package boundary) — grounding_battery and wt_spd_deleak died loudly, but stress_battery's call sits inside a try/except so its whole `numerical` category was silently recording FAIL rather than testing anything; all three repaired and re-run. The QUAL['partial'] retention rationale was mechanically WRONG (damage() gates on a literal tuple, not QUAL membership, so removal could not have caused the KeyError the comment implied) and had conflated COVERAGE_GAP['partial'], a hit-location level, with a degree — corrected in place rather than quietly reworded. description: STRUCTURAL THRESHOLDS — batch 4 of the four-dimension audit, the two discontinuities the tuning auditor found dominating the whole balance surface. (F16) WHO ACTS FIRST was decided by weapon cadence alone, accumulated metronomically from a LOCKSTEP start every engagement, so the marginally faster weapon crossed ACT_THRESHOLD first every single time: a jian's +1.5% edge bought a 2:1 action economy, and cloning an arming sword to step its mass 1.18->1.20 kg flipped the mirror 57%<->42% on a cadence delta of 0.0002 — a pure sign discontinuity that explained most of the 8-78% scatter among near-identical one-handed swords. Jordan's objection ('what happened to feinting and anticipating') rejected the first attempt, which had answered a wrong deterministic rule with unexplained Gaussian noise — fiat by another name. The shipped model instead makes the race cadence x ANTICIPATION: systems.tempo_pressure modulates the accumulation by the VOR (initiative — already decayed, disposition-drifted and STOLEN on hits, so it is earned rather than owned) and the READ (the feint is not a separate action here, WS-5 dissolved it into commit-depth and legibility, so its influence arrives through the read where it belongs). The lockstep itself is broken not with noise on the physics but by acknowledging an unknown INITIAL CONDITION — where in his own rhythm each fighter is when the blades cross — drawn uniformly across the cycle; cadence stays exactly as derived and the faster weapon still acts proportionally more often, it simply no longer owns the first action by construction. Phase transitions now carry the cadence RESIDUAL (ready mod ACT_THRESHOLD) instead of hard-zeroing, which had re-synchronised the race at every close. (F17) The closed latch `measure_gap <= 0.3` was a CLIFF worth +9pp across two centimetres of reach (katana, gap 0.22, 28.7% vs the near-identical tachi, gap 0.44, 62.5%; goedendag 80.0% vs mace 17.8%) because it decides whether an approach phase EXISTS AT ALL; it is now a probabilistic band across CLOSE_GAP_REF +- CLOSE_LATCH_BAND. (F14) ATTACKER_BIAS RETIRED as promised in batch 3's deferral: with the monopoly gone, removal measures small and clean (mirrors hold 0.50, matchups move <=0.01 except katana/mace, the biggest beneficiaries of banking the bias behind a tempo edge), so first-mover advantage now lives ONLY in the Vor. RESULT: the 1H-sword identity-erasure cohort collapses from a ~0.70 win-share spread to ~0.26 (stdev 0.084) — near-identical weapons finally perform near-identically; mirrors verified unbiased at n=4000. BATCH-3 REVIEW FIXES: per-arm cut/thrust quality sourcing — the first revision scaled BOTH arms by the blended sel_eff = max(cut, thrust), crediting an incidental edge with a dedicated point's quality (a ranseur, cut 0.30, was paid the full cutter DELIVERY 1.500 and reported as a SWING because its 0.84 thrust rode through the max); now each arm reads its own magnitude, which also correctly moves the guisarme onto its dedicated point element and the thrust-poor changdao/odachi onto Mordhau at mail. DELIVERY['cut_thrust'] became a zero-reader orphan still exported to the Godot contract — the exact class ED-PC-0035 cleaned, recreated one batch later — and is removed. The pins' ED citations were corrected and the represent-gate pin now actually CALLS the gate (it previously passed even with the room correction reverted). INSTRUMENT WORK: the reach-class test sampled n=60 at heavy where cells decide ~6% of fights, judging bands on ~8 decided fights; heavy now samples n=600 behind a decided-count floor, and the spear/yari heavy guard was RE-FRAMED off win-share (a ratio over ~30 coin-flips that wandered 0.13->0.47->0.67 without any capability changing) onto DECIDED-RATE, which carries the actual claim — plate denies a pure point the ability to decide — with the full n behind it. Full suite green (806 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed). Removed. The edit had been made and then reverted (tests/sim is the frozen tree and editing it trips the co-file + fabrication gates for no benefit); the ledger was not updated to match. KNOWN-OPEN after this entry, all raised by the review and all real: (a) the per-arm cut/thrust magnitudes are sourced from the WHOLE-WEAPON geo, not the winning ELEMENT's — so a guisarme's bill (element cut/thrust 0.76/0.19) is credited the weapon scalar 0.41 thrust, replacing a blend across ARMS with a blend across ELEMENTS (the M-02 object-confusion class element_afforded's own docstring forbids); the test_use_mode_selection re-baseline quotes the weapon scalar 0.64 where the bill's own edge is 0.76, so that re-baseline encodes the defect and must be re-derived with it. (c) The spear/yari decided-rate re-frame drops the ONE-SIDEDNESS guard: a mutation zeroing arming damage vs a heavy spearman gives the spear 90% of decided plate fights, which the OLD win-share guard caught and the NEW one passes. (d) The dec>=20 floor is itself a knife-edge — spear@heavy decides 21/600, passing by one fight — the exact F4 class this series condemned. (e) tempo_pressure is outcome-invisible (aggregate -0.06pp +- 0.27), and its READ term is identically zero in every same-stats fight; the operative F16 fix is the uniform phase draw, and the entry's 'cadence x anticipation' framing oversells a decorative modulation. (f) The Godot port still declares and ADDS attacker_bias (combat_config.gd, strike_module.gd), so port and oracle now contradict — an ED-1050 violation. description: CAPABILITY-GATED PENETRATION — batch 5 (audit findings F19/F20), plus the residuals the batch-4 review left open. THE DEFECT: the damage path and the armour-defeat path contradicted each other at plate. Measured per landed overwhelming hit vs heavy: partisan adef_cap 0.176 -> 11 damage, guandao 0.169 -> 12, ranseur 0.284 -> 9, against a spear with BETTER capability (0.288) -> 3 and a yari (0.273) -> 2. Damage keyed on head MASS while capability keys on GAP ACCESS, so the three worst plate weapons on the board were the ones punching through it — physically inverted (a narrow point seeks a harness gap better than a broad blade), and a silent contradiction of the armour-defeat model every other part of the engine resolves on. It also quietly undercut ED-PC-0033's own story: those weapons were not 'earning presentations', they were exploiting a damage leak. THE FIX: the ED-PC-0032 penetration knee is now CAPABILITY-RELATIVE — t rises with the weapon's own armour-defeat deficit (t *= 1 + PEN_DEFICIT_K*max(0, ADEF_THRESHOLD[tier] - adef_cap)) — so what passes a harness is governed by whether the weapon can defeat it rather than by how heavy its head is. A weapon that clears the tier is untouched (deficit 0), and none/light stay completely inert (PEN_THR 0). To do this without duplicating a rule, adef_cap was MOVED to core as its single owner and combat_systems now delegates — the damage path and the sigma path literally share one function. RESULT: partisan 11->3, guandao 12->3, ranseur 9->2, spear/yari/estoc -> 0, guisarme -> 1, while the genuine plate-defeaters keep their teeth (mace 17, poleaxe 10, dagger 9, jian 4). Only weapons that actually clear the tier can now decide a plate fight, which is the point. TEST CONSEQUENCES, all re-based honestly: spear@heavy now decides 0 of 600 fights — a total stalemate, the STRONGEST form of the property being asserted, so an undefined win-share is recorded rather than a division by zero; the guisarme plate guard is re-based on the same reasoning (it can no longer sweep, and may settle nothing), which also retires the batch-4 ceiling question the previous entry flagged for re-derivation — there is no runaway left to bound. RESIDUALS CLOSED from batch 4.1: element-local per-arm cut/thrust magnitudes now reach core.strike (via systems.selected_arm_magnitudes, written by the wrapper alongside the other sel_* fields), so a composite is damaged on the element actually struck rather than the whole-weapon bake; and the Godot port no longer declares or ADDS attacker_bias, which had left port and oracle contradicting after ED-PC-0037 retired it — an ED-1050 violation. Full suite green (806 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed). STILL OPEN: batch 6 (ADEF_CUT grading by mass/keenness, the sparr_axe/falchion/greatsword roster gaps, the hollow eff_cw ability channels) and the off-plate reach re-tune toward Jordan's ~0.75 target, which the structural work enabled but did not perform.

description: PENETRATION-KNEE CORRECTIONS — the adversarial review of ED-PC-0038 returned 'half-stands' and was right. (F2, the real bug) The deficit was computed from a RAW adef_cap, but adef_cap can return NEGATIVE: ADEF_CUT is -0.9, a sigma-domain CONTROL PENALTY calibrated for armor_defeat_sigma's +/- scale, not a capability magnitude. A pure cutter therefore got a deficit of 1.62 at plate — more than twice the entire threshold scale — and a knee inflated ~x10.7, which silently annihilated the whole cutter class (bardiche 17->1, podao 13->1, sparr_axe 11->1 per hit) and spilled onto MEDIUM, a tier the fix was never meant to touch (sparr_axe 0.32->0.05, staff 0.22->0.04). Capability is now clamped at 0 before the deficit: 'cannot defeat the harness' is a floor at zero, not an unbounded negative, and grading HOW badly a given cut fails is ADEF_CUT's job in the sigma path (and the batch-6 mass/keenness work), not this knee's. Restores bardiche 4, podao 3, sparr_axe 2 while the defeaters keep their teeth. (F7) The knee now threads grip/room, so it and armor_defeat_sigma resolve the SAME circumstance — the previous entry's claim that the two paths 'literally share one function' was true of the function but not of its arguments. (F1) A plate-PARTICIPATION guard is restored. Tolerating an undefined share everywhere at plate had deleted a load-bearing check, and the review proved it with two mutations the re-based suite sailed through: core.strike returning 0 for the guisarme vs heavy, and every long-lever point returning 0 vs heavy — a whole class losing all plate function. The restored guard asserts the property that must survive capability-gating: plate combat is not universally MUTE, i.e. a weapon that genuinely defeats a harness must still settle fights there. (F4) PEN_DEFICIT_K was shipped unswept. Swept and recorded (per-hit vs heavy): K=0 partisan 11 / spear 3 / bardiche 17 / poleaxe 13; K=6 partisan 3 / spear 0 / bardiche 4 / poleaxe 10; K=12 partisan 1 / poleaxe 7. Mace (17) and dagger (9) are K-INVARIANT at every value because their capability clears the tier and their deficit is 0 — the design behaving as intended. K=6 retained. MEASURED AND REPORTED, not discovered in review: (F3) plate decidability. 34 of 51 weapons now decide ZERO of 120 fights vs arming at heavy, 3 more under 5%. Only genuine harness-defeaters (daggers, estoc/half-sword forms, mace/poleaxe/bec/lucerne/goedendag) settle plate fights. This is defensible under PC-5 doctrine and matches the historical picture (you kill a plated man with a dagger to the gaps, a hammer, or by putting him on the ground), but it is a large behavioural fact that ED-PC-0038 shipped without stating. KNOWN-OPEN, honestly: (F5) the flagship principle is ATTENUATED, NOT ACHIEVED. At equal capability, head mass still orders penetration — partisan (cap 0.176) out-damages spear (cap 0.288, BETTER) at every K, because the knee scrubs a small raw value to zero long before it scrubs a large one. A knee cannot express 'capability orders penetration'; that needs capability to gate multiplicatively rather than through a magnitude threshold, which is a batch-6 redesign. (F6) the same deficit scalar now enters four multiplicative channels (armor_defeat_sigma, reach_threat, represent_measure_p, this knee) with no recorded double-count budget, against a repo rule that forbids exactly that. (F8) PEN_DEFICIT_K is exported to a Godot contract whose port has no penetration knee at all — pre-existing parity red, now carrying a second orphan constant.

description: ED-PC-0039 REVIEW CORRECTIONS — the adversarial review of ED-PC-0039 returned 'half-stands' for the third batch running, and was right. It was dispatched with an explicit adversarial prior (two consecutive fixes on this path had each introduced a new defect). Its verified-green list stands: the 806-test claim, the x10.7/1.62 arithmetic, 'defeaters untouched' by the clamp, the F7 argument-threading fix, the genuineness of the post-clamp K sweep, and no data loss in the register compression. WHAT DID NOT SURVIVE. (S1, the real defect) ED-PC-0039's 'restored plate-participation guard' asserted one weapon: decided[poleaxe,heavy] > 0.50. The review killed bec_de_corbin + lucerne_hammer + goedendag at plate simultaneously — three quarters of the percussive defeater class going mute — and the full 806-test suite PASSED. FIX: test_plate_participation_tracks_armour_defeat_capability, roster-wide and PRIMITIVE-DERIVED. Capability = max(adef_cap) over every mode AND every grip reachable in a fight, including the HALFSWORD_FORM target the wrapper swaps into when closed vs medium/heavy — without that clause the estoc (base point cap 0.522) and longsword (0.613) read sub-threshold while being the two most decisive plate weapons on the board, because in a real fight they half-sword to 1.104 and 1.020. Measured partition (n=200 vs arming): cap>=0.9 -> 13 weapons deciding 0.59-0.99; 0.72<=cap<0.9 -> main_gauche 0.23; cap<0.45 -> 40 weapons at 0.00-0.12. Three clauses: FORWARD (every comfortable defeater settles >35%), CLASS-COUNT (at most 2 of 13 below 50% — catches a partial die-off a per-weapon floor lets through), CONVERSE (nothing far below threshold settles >=40% — catches a covert plate-killer). Mutation-verified: the bec/lucerne/goedendag kill now fails, naming all three. (S1b) The two mutations ED-PC-0039 cited are, at the decided-rate level, NULL, and claiming otherwise was the error. Measured: zeroing the guisarme at plate moves its decided-rate 0.00 -> 0.00 (517 of 1572 strikes land nonzero but never accumulate a decision); zeroing every long-lever point moves spear/yari/ji/spetum/dangpa/bear_spear/guisarme 0.00 -> 0.00. The ONLY weapon either mutation observably moves is the ranseur (0.12 -> 0.00), whose plate participation is itself a defect — so guarding these mutations would guard a defect into permanence, and this entry does not. (S2) A guard comment asserted something false about its own subject: 'capability clears the tier BY CONSTRUCTION, so it cannot be satisfied by luck'. True only statically — the poleaxe's blunt cap is 1.216 vs 0.72, but the cap it REALIZES depends on the mode it selects turn by turn (mean ~0.60), and the same commit's K-sweep shows the poleaxe is not K-invariant (13/10/7 at K=0/6/12), contradicting the framing. Corrected in place; the floor is empirical. (S8) RETRACTION. ED-PC-0038's ledger recorded 'spear/yari/estoc -> 0' damage per landed hit at plate. The ESTOC is the single most decisive plate weapon in the roster — 99% of its plate fights settled, 93% of strikes nonzero, mean 12.84 — because it auto-half-swords to the highest point capability on the board (1.104). The spear is not 0 either (0.22 nonzero rate, mean 0.22). Only the yari is near-0. The original entry is left intact (append-only ledger); this is the correction of record. (S5) The covert plate-killer has a name: the RANSEUR, cap 0.284 against a 0.72 threshold, settles ~12% of its plate fights and wins ~100% of what it settles. guandao (cap 0.127) lands mean 2.76/strike and partisan (0.171) 1.96, against a spear with BETTER capability (0.288) at 0.22. The knee is a graded threshold multiplier, not a gate, so raw magnitude still buys through. F19's residual, localised. Guarded in the direction it must not regress; explicitly not guarded away. (S3) MEASURED AND DISCLOSED, not caught in review: the MEDIUM tier never round-tripped, and ED-PC-0039 made one weapon worse. ED-PC-0038 called mail 'a tier the fix was never meant to touch'. Share vs arming at medium, n=200, pre-0038 -> 0038 -> 0039: odachi 0.67/0.44/0.26 (-41pp, and 0039 caused the last -18), naginata 0.82/0.57/0.57, staff 0.21/0.09/0.09, podao 0.61/0.32/0.44, sparr_axe 0.36/0.07/0.22, changdao 0.87/0.82/0.79, tachi 0.37/0.36/0.31; greatsword/flamberge/katana/sabre/falchion/glaive flat. Two causes, neither the one 0039 fixed: staff and naginata were NEVER in the ADEF_CUT branch (they select blunt and cut_thrust, caps 0.149/0.244, positive — the clamp could not touch them), so their loss is 0038's deficit knee working as designed at a tier nobody re-baselined; and the odachi's extra -18pp is 0039's OWN grip/room threading, which makes the knee read the grip-corrected capability (more correct) and lowered its per-strike damage 3.67 -> 2.77. Disclosed, not reverted. (S4) The clamp erased grading INSIDE the class it rescued: every pure cutter now floors to capability 0, so the knee cannot distinguish a bardiche from a shamshir. Right as a floor, wrong as a model — batch 6's F21 (mass/keenness grading of ADEF_CUT in the sigma path) must now carry that distinction, because 0039 removed the only place it was being expressed. (S9) The audit index overclaimed its own review record (commit 257d9a7 said 'both reviews so far returned stands, nothing reverted' when batches 4 and 5 had both half-stood), and HANDOFF_PC.md had not been updated since batch 3. Both corrected. NEW FINDING (F24), surfaced by following the review through: SELECTION CONTRADICTS DAMAGE. Instrumenting core.strike by selected head at plate over the whole roster shows select_mode repeatedly choosing a head that provably cannot wound what it faces — falchion selects point on 46 of 47 plate strikes for 0 damage every time; glaive 59 point strikes at 0; sabre 56 at 0; podao selects point (35 strikes, mean 0.00) over its own curved_cut (10 strikes, mean 2.40) 78% of the time; ten weapons land literally zero across the sample. At MEDIUM every 2H sword flips to blunt (odachi 703/703 strikes) for mean 2.77 against the arming sword's 8.48. This is the ED-PC-0038 defect class one layer up: 0038 reconciled DAMAGE with CAPABILITY, but SELECTION is still keyed on afforded effectiveness with no reference to whether the chosen head can defeat the armour in front of it. DELIBERATELY NOT PATCHED HERE — it is a select_mode change with golden-parity blast radius, and bundling it into a review-response commit is exactly the pattern that made batches 4, 5 and 5.1 all half-stand. Batch-6 head item. META-REVIEW -> ENFORCEMENT (Jordan: 'convert all lessons into enforcement and guardrails'). Batches 4, 5 and 5.1 all half-stood for ONE cause, and it is not subtle physics: quantitative claims were written into ledger entries and code comments faster than they were measured, and the scripts that would have falsified them were ad-hoc and thrown away. Measured shape: ~31k characters of ledger prose across ED-PC-0034..0040, config.py at 74% comment density, batch 5.1 shipping +27/-5 lines of code wrapped in ~3.5k characters of claim. Converted into gates, not resolutions (a resolution is what failed three times). (1) MEASUREMENT IS NOW A COMMITTED ARTIFACT: workbench/armour_participation.py — four views (participation / strikes / tiers / --drift) reproducing every number in this entry. (2) GUARDS ARE MUTATION-TESTED: test_plate_participation_guard_is_not_blind applies declared mutations that MUST make the participation guard fail AND be NAMED in its failure message (the name check matters — pytest.raises alone would let sampling noise read as 'mutation caught' while the guard stayed blind). All four declared mutations verified caught. (3) EVERY RULE LIVES ONCE: the CI guard IMPORTS capability()/_duel() from the instrument rather than re-deriving them; the first draft inlined a copy, which is the same duplication class as the bug. (4) COLLATERAL TIER DAMAGE IS NOW VISIBLE: tests/valoria/data/combat_armour_reference.json (full roster x all four tiers, n=40, deterministic seeds) + test_combat_armour_reference.py at 0.15 tolerance; regeneration is manual and THE DIFF IS THE DISCLOSURE. Verified to FIRE on a real change (PEN_DEFICIT_K 6.0->2.0 flags 13 cells by name) — a gate that has never failed is decoration. (5) MEASURED CLAIMS NAME A SOURCE: tools/ci_claim_provenance_check.py, blocking, CI job claim-provenance-check + valoria_local.py, registered in ci_checks_registry.yaml. LIMITS STATED PLAINLY: the provenance gate verifies a source is NAMED AND PRESENT, not that a number is CORRECT (same limit CLAUDE.md §7 records for the anti-fabrication gate); its cutover is an ID not a date (ED-PC-0040 forward) because every entry in the failing arc shares the date of the entry establishing the rule, so a date cutover would exempt the rule from itself — the five grandfathered entries are corrected by retraction above, not excused; and the drift gate is defeated the moment someone regenerates the reference to turn a build green without reading the diff. WHAT NO GATE HERE FIXES: the treadmill. F19 (damage vs capability), F24 (selection vs damage) and S4 (grading inside the cutter class) are ONE defect — three separate models of what a weapon does to armour, reconciled pairwise by patch, each batch closing one pair and exposing the next. That is a design call for Jordan, not something a validator can enforce. Full suite green.
